import {zoneVisibilityIsManaged} from '../render/OcclusionByWall.js';
export const proof=(root,shallow=false)=>{const nodes=new Set();if(shallow)nodes.add(root);else root.traverse(o=>nodes.add(o));for(let p=root.parent;p;p=p.parent)nodes.add(p);return [...nodes].map(o=>({object:new WeakRef(o),parent:o.parent?new WeakRef(o.parent):null,visible:o.visible,managedLOD:o.parent?.isLOD?o.parent.levels.findIndex(level=>level.object===o):-1,lodDistance:o.parent?.isLOD?o.parent.levels.find(level=>level.object===o)?.distance:null,children:o===root||o.isMesh?o.children.map(c=>c.uuid):null,transform:[...o.position.toArray(),...o.quaternion.toArray(),...o.scale.toArray()],geometry:o.geometry?new WeakRef(o.geometry):null,position:o.geometry?.attributes.position?new WeakRef(o.geometry.attributes.position):null,version:o.geometry?.attributes.position?.version,positionArray:o.geometry?.attributes.position?.array?new WeakRef(o.geometry.attributes.position.array):null,positionShape:o.geometry?.attributes.position?[o.geometry.attributes.position.count,o.geometry.attributes.position.itemSize]:null,index:o.geometry?.index?new WeakRef(o.geometry.index):null,indexVersion:o.geometry?.index?.version,indexArray:o.geometry?.index?.array?new WeakRef(o.geometry.index.array):null,indexShape:o.geometry?.index?[o.geometry.index.count,o.geometry.index.itemSize]:null,draw:o.geometry?[o.geometry.drawRange.start,o.geometry.drawRange.count]:null,material:o.material?new WeakRef(o.material):null,materialState:o.material?[o.material.visible,o.material.side,o.material.opacity]:null}));};
export const proofCurrent=(rows,allowVisibility=()=>false)=>rows.every(r=>{const o=r.object.deref();if(!o||o.parent!==(r.parent?.deref()??null))return false;if(r.managedLOD>=0){const level=o.parent?.levels?.[r.managedLOD];if(level?.object!==o||level.distance!==r.lodDistance)return false;}else if(o.visible!==r.visible&&!zoneVisibilityIsManaged(o)&&!allowVisibility(o,r.visible))return false;const t=r.transform;if(o.position.x!==t[0]||o.position.y!==t[1]||o.position.z!==t[2]||o.quaternion.x!==t[3]||o.quaternion.y!==t[4]||o.quaternion.z!==t[5]||o.quaternion.w!==t[6]||o.scale.x!==t[7]||o.scale.y!==t[8]||o.scale.z!==t[9])return false;if(r.children&&(o.children.length!==r.children.length||o.children.some((c,i)=>c.uuid!==r.children[i])))return false;if(r.geometry&&(o.geometry!==r.geometry.deref()||o.geometry.attributes.position!==r.position?.deref()||o.geometry.attributes.position?.version!==r.version||o.geometry.attributes.position?.array!==r.positionArray?.deref()||o.geometry.attributes.position?.count!==r.positionShape?.[0]||o.geometry.attributes.position?.itemSize!==r.positionShape?.[1]||o.geometry.index!==(r.index?.deref()??null)||o.geometry.index?.version!==r.indexVersion||o.geometry.index?.array!==r.indexArray?.deref()||o.geometry.index?.count!==r.indexShape?.[0]||o.geometry.index?.itemSize!==r.indexShape?.[1]||o.geometry.drawRange.start!==r.draw[0]||o.geometry.drawRange.count!==r.draw[1]))return false;return !r.material||(o.material===r.material.deref()&&o.material.visible===r.materialState[0]&&o.material.side===r.materialState[1]&&o.material.opacity===r.materialState[2]);});
